overview.text: This document outlines the Schedule of Quantities for the construction work titled 'Construction of Permanent Campus Phase B' at Syadhri Campus, which includes specific tasks such as laying a road in front of the Director Bungalow.

scope.text: Earthwork involving surface excavation not exceeding 30 cm in depth but exceeding 1.5 m in width, including disposal of excavated earth up to 50 m.
Preparation and consolidation of sub grade using a power road roller of 8 to 12 tonne capacity after excavating earth to an average of 22.5 cm depth, dressing to camber, and consolidating.
Providing and laying 150GSM filter fabric made of PP Stable fibre Non-Woven, Needle Punched Geotextile with specified tensile strength and UV resistance properties.

Construction of granular sub-base by providing close graded material conforming to specifications, mixing in a mechanical mix plant at OMC, carriage by tippers, spreading in uniform layers with motor grader, and compacting with vibratory power roller.

Providing and laying bituminous macadam using crushed stone aggregates of specified grading premixed with bituminous binder, transported to site by tippers, laid over a previously prepared surface with a paver finisher equipped with an electronic sensor.
Providing and applying tack coat using hot straight run bitumen of grade VG - 10, including heating the bitumen and spraying it with a mechanically operated spray unit fitted on a bitumen boiler.
Providing and laying at or near ground level factory made kerb stone of M-25 grade cement concrete in position to the required line, level, and curvature.
Providing and laying 60 mm thick factory made cement concrete interlocking paver block of M -30 grade made by a block making machine with strong vibratory compaction.

key_requirements.text: All items must be complete as per specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
Materials must conform to specified grades, such as Grade-II for stone aggregate and VG-30/30 bitumen.
A Hot Mix Plant of 60-90 TPH capacity is required for preparing materials.
A paver finisher equipped with an electronic sensor to the required grade, level, and alignment is required.
Factory made kerb stone shall be approved by the Engineer-in-charge.

commercial_requirements.text: Payment shall be made for kerb edging measured by the length of finished kerb edging to calculate volume for payment.
Precast C.C. kerb stone shall be approved by the Engineer-in-charge.
